data.investment_objective: To generate returns through a combination of dividend income and capital appreciation by investing primarily in a well-diversified portfolio of value stocks. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
• Equity & Equity related instruments = 65% - 100%
• Debt and Money Market Instruments including Units of Debt oriented mutual fund schemes = 0% - 35%
data.exit_load:
1% of the applicable Net Asset Value - if the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period of up to 12 months from the date of allotment.
NIL - if the amount sought to be redeemed or switch out is invested for a period more than 12 months from the date of allotment
